title: The most-used words
prompt:
A weather diary is a text of lowercase words separated by single spaces. You want the words that appear most often.

Write `topWords(text, k)` that takes a string `text` (0 to 40 words, no leading, trailing or double spaces; an empty string has no words) and a whole number `k` from 1 to 10, and returns an array of the `k` most frequent words, most frequent first. If two words appear equally often, the one that comes first in alphabetical order goes first. If the text has fewer than `k` different words, return all of them.

Examples:

- `topWords("rain sun rain fog sun rain", 2)` returns `["rain","sun"]`
- `topWords("b a c", 5)` returns `["a","b","c"]`
